text: {"name":"rf_iq_dc_offset_correct","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Scans an IQ sample capture, detects saturated samples, computes average I/Q DC offsets, and rewrites each packed sample with the DC offset subtracted while preserving the low status bits.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v0":"align_offset","v1":"min_i","v2":"sample_start","v3":"sample_end_word","v4":"sample_cur","v5":"sample_end","v6":"max_q","v7":"max_i","v8":"sum_q","v9":"sum_i","v10":"i_sample","v11":"q_sample","v12":"raw_sample","v13":"i_sample","v14":"q_sample","v16":"centered_i"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"packed IQ sample word: I in bits 20-31, Q in bits 4-15; bits 0 and 16 are status/valid bits preserved or set on rewrite"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"unused second 32-bit word of each 8-byte sample record, skipped by the +2 int stride"}]}
